newsitem.title: USA: Three U.S. Army officers jailed on sex charges.
newsitem.headline: Three U.S. Army officers jailed on sex charges.

text.p: Three Army officers at Fort Bliss in Texas have been kicked out of the military and sent to prison for sexual misconduct, officials said Friday.

The three, sentenced to from three months to 20 months in prison, were named in a complaint that accused 19 officers and soldiers at the base of sexual misconduct with female enlisted soldiers. Nine others soldiers named in the complaint have already received administrative punishments.
"I want to make it clear that this was not a ring of offenders," Fort Bliss spokesman Tom Collins said. "They were all separate and distinct cases."

The three officers pleaded guilty at court-martial hearings in the past few weeks. 2nd Lt. Trevor Gordon was sentenced to 20 months in prison, Maj. Eddie Brenham was given six months and Capt. Ivan Brown was handed a three-month term.
They were discharged from the army and will serve their terms in Fort Leavinworth, Kansas.

Fort Bliss has been hit by a string of sexual complaints, including one that led to the removal of Col. Robert Jordan, commander of the army's Sergeant Major Academy. He was accused of sexual misconduct with a civilian female employee.

Thirteen former and current employees have pooled together in a class action lawsuit against Fort Bliss, demanding $4 million from the base for allegedly allowing sexual misconduct and harassment. The case is set to go to trial in August.

The Texas case coincided with a major sexual misconduct investigation at the Aberdeen Proving Ground in Maryland, which has become the military's biggest sexual harassment scandal since the Navy's 1991 Tailhook affair.

Staff Sgt. Delmar Simpson, who is accused of raping six female trainees, is the first of 12 trainers charged with various acts of misconduct at Aberdeen to go before a court-martial, which resumed deliberations Friday.
Four cases were settled earlier through plea agreements or administrative proceedings.
